article_notes: Retrospective questionnaire study of 342 PCR/sequencing-confirmed B. canis dogs from samples submitted to a diagnostic laboratory in Germany (mostly primary-care vets). Outcome known for 193 dogs: 24 complicated (13 died, including euthanasia), 169 uncomplicated. Complicated course is not defined. The only factor reported against outcome is travel/import history (descriptive, no test). Same 342 dogs as an earlier report by the same group on parasitaemia, acute phase response and serology. Antibody-level statements in the discussion come from that other study and are not extracted.

severity_definitions.label: died vs survived
severity_definitions.definition: Death or euthanasia among the 193 dogs with outcome information (mortality 6.7%).

severity_definitions.label: complicated vs uncomplicated course
severity_definitions.definition: Course reported by the treating veterinarian as complicated or uncomplicated; complications not defined.
severity_definitions.quote: Uncomplicated courses were reported in 169 of 193 dogs (87.6%, 95% CI: 82.2–91.5%), complicated courses in 24 of 193 dogs (12.4%, 95% CI: 8.5–17.8%).

associations.statistic: mortality: travelled 3/20 (15.0%); no stays abroad 6.9% (7 of 101 with outcome)
associations.quote: Of the 20 dogs that had travelled, 3 died (mortality rate: 15.0%).
associations.note: Values are mortality within history categories (not history frequency by outcome group), so severe/comparison values left null. Direction from the printed rates; no test.

associations.statistic: imported: all 40 survived (100% survival rate); no stays abroad mortality 6.9%
associations.quote: Of the 40 imported dogs with available information on the outcome, all had uncomplicated courses and a 100% survival rate.
associations.note: Authors attribute this to pre-existing immunity (not measured here). No test.

associations.statistic: imported: 40/40 uncomplicated; no stays abroad: complicated with survival 7 (6.9%) and complicated with death 7 of 101
associations.quote: In this group, complicated course with survival was described for 7 dogs (6.9%, 95% CI: 3.4–13.6%), and complicated courses with subsequent death or euthanasia were reported for another 7 dogs
associations.note: Rates are within history categories; no test.
